entries.status: No EU-level schedule or class. EU legislation does not establish classes of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Member States classify drugs according to the 1961, 1971 and 1988 UN Conventions. The Framework Decision on illicit drug trafficking defines 'drug' as any substance covered by the 1961 Single Convention (as amended by the 1972 Protocol) or by the 1971 Convention, or listed in its Annex.

entries.note: The 1971 Schedule 1 rows are unnumbered in the list; the position (of 35 rows) was counted in both readings. The 1971 Schedule 1 list ends with a salts clause and a stereoisomers clause ("The stereoisomers, unless specifically excepted, of substances in this Schedule"). No cactus is named in any list read (searched: peyote, Lophophora, San Pedro, Trichocereus, Echinopsis, cactus), so the "if named" cactus item has no row. Board Regulation No. 3, Series of 2019 (plants containing listed substances, or sources thereof; title only) could not be read to see whether it names any plant.
